en.title: Baked Rice in Milk (

steps.n1: Soak the rice for about one hour.
steps.n2: Prepare a Pyrex dish, lightly grease it with a spoonful of ghee, then add the rice.
steps.n3: Pour the hot milk, seasoned with salt and pepper, over the rice and cover.
steps.n4: Place in a medium-heat oven until it is nearly cooked.
steps.n5: Melt a spoonful of ghee and pour it over the surface of the rice after removing the cover, then leave until fully cooked.
